facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica says Mauritius Telecom's Tier IV data centre at Rose Belle offers secure data hosting, disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.

facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica reports the ICT minister toured Mauritius Telecom's Rose Belle data centre as preparations advance to host government data, including sensitive eHealth information, there.
facts.system: Rose Belle data centre for government data

MUS.note: Hosting is only in preparation, so no hosted fact.
A digital transformation agenda is mentioned only in passing, with no instrument named.
The Tier IV centre's ownership is not stated, and government hosting is only in preparation.
No government backup site in service, in a named place or at distance, is stated.
